cases.scope: Greedy raster packing on K (0.25 mm, obstacles as the capacity census, 0.35 mm between placed parts, no rotation; every position re-checked with the scene exact predicate except the displacement cap): the IC nearest its original x/y on the better face, then each member nearest the IC on the same face; one-hop block boundary from the remedy brief (trimmers stay with the trimmer plan; a part shared by two blocks is placed once), not a stability model; crossing-net count is not an allocation (class and ground rules not applied). Room and count only.
